description: Local hybrid (vector + full-text) code search and two-level memory for Claude Code.
stack: Python 3.12 (typer, SQLite, sqlite-vec, FTS5) and a vanilla-JS UI

ui.check: Light and dark theme, narrow width; Claude in Chrome extension only.

slots.coder_keywords: implement, feature, command, refactor, fix, CLI, daemon, UI
coder_rules: - Stack: Python 3.12, uv, typer, SQLite + sqlite-vec + FTS5; UI: vanilla JS in `src/myvec/ui` (no build step, the Project-B design system: Geist, oklch tokens; the interface language is Ukrainian, numbers `uk-UA`). Follow the conventions of the neighboring code.
- Secrets: do not weaken `filters.py`, the `•••` masking, the dropping of PEM keys and tokens. New file types go into the index only with a secrets check.
- Do not change the model and the search parameters "by eye", only through `bench/`.
- Tests do not touch the real `~/MyVector` etc.; do not use `monkeypatch.undo()` (it removes the `MYVEC_HOME` patch).
- Updating the installation: `uv tool install --reinstall --python 3.12 .`; do not hardcode Mac or devbox paths in code and scripts.
slots.tester_cases: Edge cases, errors, secrets (masking, dropping), `MYVEC_HOME` in a tmp dir (the autouse fixture `env` in `tests/conftest.py`). Not `monkeypatch.undo()`: restore a specific attribute via `monkeypatch.setattr(..., real)`.
slots.tester_isolation: Nothing that hits the real `~/MyVector`, Ollama or the network: fake embedders and servers, as in the existing tests. Time-dependent tests use a fixed time.
slots.tester_run: `myvec measure --ticket <ID> --agent tester --label full -- uv run pytest -q`. On devbox the node tests need a PATH with nvm: `PATH=$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.4/bin:$PATH myvec measure --ticket <ID> --agent tester --label full -- uv run pytest -q`. In a worktree without a fresh `myvec` (no `measure`) use `uv run myvec measure ...`. A rerun of the flaky `test_real_watchdog_smoke` also goes through the wrapper with `--label rerun`.
slots.planner_read: README.md, CLAUDE.md, `bench/REPORT.md` (if it touches search or the model)
slots.planner_risks: the DB schema and the index migration (the DB is derived, `myvec rebuild`; the vault is the source of truth), secrets and filters (do not weaken `filters.py`), ranking and the model (change only through `bench/`), noise in the index, two platforms (launchd/systemd), compatibility with indexes already deployed on two machines, test isolation (`MYVEC_HOME`)
reviewer_checks: - Correctness: logic, boundaries, races (daemon + CLI + watcher, `sync.lock`), idempotence, error handling, SQL (parameters, transactions), consistency of the DB and the vault.

- Security: secrets in the index, logs and responses, bypassing `filters.py`, path traversal and symlinks in the indexer, injections in FTS5/SQL queries, the web API on :7878 (binding to 127.0.0.1, XSS/CSRF in the UI), file permissions.
- Ranking and search: changes to RRF, scope weights or the model without a new `bench/` run = Important.
- Two platforms: launchd/systemd, paths, `install.sh` (idempotence, macOS and Linux).
- Test quality: the name matches the check, no empty or always-green asserts, tests do not touch the real `~/MyVector`, no `monkeypatch.undo()`.
- Fit to the ticket: nothing extra and nothing missing; real data and secrets did not reach the repository.
slots.qa_description: Live verification of the installed myvec: reinstall, daemon, live search, UI on :7878.
slots.qa_keywords: QA, live check, browser, screenshot, UI, layout, live search
qa_steps: 1. Take "Перевірка наживо" from the ticket. Install and restart the daemon only if the orchestrator allowed it: `uv tool install --reinstall --python 3.12 .`, `myvec install-daemon`.
2. Live search in 2-3 projects: a natural-language query (uk/ru) and an identifier; `--scope all` for cross-project. Judge relevance and the absence of secrets in the results.

3. UI: http://127.0.0.1:7878, light and dark theme, narrow width. On every screenshot look at the whole design: text sticking out or clipped, no gaps between neighboring elements, duplicated labels, overlaps, extra line breaks, number and time formats for Ukrainian (`uk-UA`: "3 671", 24-hour time; `3,671` and `12:00 AM` are defects).
4. Describe an obvious layout defect in steps and with a screenshot description; the coder fixes it.
5. The real `~/MyVector` is read-only, except where the ticket directly requires otherwise. Do not quote secrets that appeared in the results by accident: report the fact and the place.
6. Into the ticket's `## Log`: the list of scenarios, passed/failed, defects, the `measure:` line of every test run as is.

7. Any test run in the live check (pytest, node, npm) goes through `myvec measure --ticket <ID> --agent qa -- ...` (rules: `skill/myvector/tickets.md`, "Test runs"; in a worktree without a fresh `myvec` use `uv run myvec measure`). The `measure:` line goes into the Log (item 6) and into the status. The real `~/MyVector` then gets a line in the run journal (`test_runs`): this is an expected record, not a violation of "read-only". Do not use the wrapper for `true` or experiments.
slots.docs_targets: README.md (commands, schema, architecture: the full description), CLAUDE.md (only non-obvious things and pitfalls, briefly), `skill/myvector/SKILL.md` (if the commands or the skill behavior changed), `bench/REPORT.md` (only if a benchmark was run), `docs/decisions.md` (ADRs)
slots.debugger_repro: a test, a `myvec` command, daemon logs (launchd, `journalctl --user -u myvec`), read-only
slots.debugger_checks: check the DB schema and the lock state (`sync already running` is the daemon, do not kill processes)
slots.debugger_data: ; do not change the data of the real `~/MyVector`
slots.live_check_trigger: When the ticket touches the installed tool, the daemon, search or the UI:
live_check_steps: 1. `uv tool install --reinstall --python 3.12 .` (or `./install.sh`), then `myvec install-daemon` (restart). Without `--reinstall` uv installs the cached old build.
2. Live search in 2-3 projects: a natural-language query (uk/ru) and an identifier; `--scope all`.
3. UI: http://127.0.0.1:7878 - only the Claude in Chrome extension (`mcp__claude-in-chrome__*`), do not use the chrome-devtools MCP. Light and dark theme, narrow width (`resize_window`).
4. After changes to `filters.py`/secrets - scan the DB for PEM/AKIA/tokens. `sync already running` - wait, do not kill the daemon's processes.
The real `~/MyVector` is read-only unless the ticket requires otherwise.
slots.install_rule: Reinstalling `myvec` on the machines and restarting the daemon happen only on the user's explicit command. Agents do not touch the real `~/MyVector`, `~/.claude`, LaunchAgents/systemd.
slots.workflow_docs: README/CLAUDE.md/`docs/lessons.md`/`docs/decisions.md`/`bench/REPORT.md` (if search or the model was touched)
slots.parallel_note: - Tests are isolated through `MYVEC_HOME`, but the daemon and the real index are one: do not run parallel qa runs.
